name: BlockBlast Friend Edition
storyline:
A strange collection of colorful blocks has appeared in a mysterious 8×8 world.

Each block carries the face of a different character from the Friend Edition universe. Three pieces are presented at a time, but their shapes and colors are constantly changing. Your mission is to place them strategically and keep the board from filling up.

Whenever a complete row or column is formed, the blocks disappear in a burst of energy, giving you points and creating more space for new pieces.

But the board never stops becoming more difficult to manage. Every decision matters. A badly placed block can close off valuable spaces, while a clever combination can clear multiple lines and create a huge score bonus.

There is no final boss, no destination and no time limit.

Only the board, the blocks and your high score.

Keep placing.
Keep clearing.
Keep going until there is nowhere left to play.
summary:
Block Blast Friend Edition is a casual puzzle game where you place colorful blocks on an 8×8 grid and try to achieve the highest score possible.

Choose from three randomly generated pieces and drag them onto the board. Complete full rows or columns to clear them and earn bonus points. Each piece has a different shape, forcing you to carefully plan your moves and manage the limited space on the board.

The game features colorful blocks decorated with characters from the Friend Edition universe, satisfying clearing animations, score pop-ups, confetti effects and a local high-score system.

There is no timer and no fixed number of levels. The game ends when none of the available pieces can be placed on the board.

How long can you keep the board alive, and how high can you push your score?
